name: playpets
description: A yard where your pets talk to each other
author: gaerae

scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm test && pnpm run site:build
scripts.test: pnpm run test:rust && pnpm run test:js
scripts.test:e2e: cargo build --profile e2e --features e2e --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && node tests/e2e.mjs
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:rust && pnpm run lint:js && pnpm run lint:css
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.format: pnpm run format:rust && pnpm run format:js
scripts.site:dev: pnpm run site:prepare && vitepress dev website
scripts.site:build: pnpm run site:prepare && vitepress build website
scripts.shots: cargo build --profile e2e --features e2e --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && node scripts/shots.mjs
scripts.measure: cargo build --profile e2e --features e2e --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && node scripts/measure.mjs
scripts.security:check: gitleaks git --redact --no-banner --log-opts=--all && pnpm audit --audit-level high && cargo audit --file src-tauri/Cargo.lock
